theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

top_news.title: Yen Jumps on US Data as Traders Watch for Intervention Clues
top_news.summary: The yen surged against a weaker dollar after an unexpectedly soft US payrolls report on Friday, with traders on alert for any sign authorities were preparing to intervene in the Japanese currency again.

top_news.title: Optimizing Life and Finances in Your Twenties | Masters in Business with Jack Raines
top_news.summary: Barry sits down with Jack Raines author of "Younge Money". Jack dives into his unlikely journey into finance and venture capital. He discusses how his travels impacted the way he sees money and purpose in your twenties. He also reviews how to incorporate passion into your career and the impact it will have in your long-term finances. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Innovation Doesn't Happen Without Crisis: Rolapp
top_news.summary: Brian Rolapp, CEO of PGA Tour, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss the changing landscape of sports media coverage, the rising costs of streaming bills for consumers, and the evolution of the PGA Tour after the rise and fall of LIV Golf. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Once Upon a Farm CEO on Outlook Boost, Consumer Demand
top_news.summary: John Foraker, Co-Founder and CEO of Once Upon a Farm, discussed the company's strong 42% sales growth in the recent quarter and expressed confidence in sustaining this momentum due to resilient consumer demand across baby and kid food categories. The company has raised its guidance for the full year and anticipates continued growth. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: US Army Wants to Let Companies Test Weapons Faster
top_news.summary: The US Army wants to see new weapons on the battlefield faster. Tyler Kendall sat down with US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll to discuss the Pentagon's plan to open up five military ranges to private industry.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Markets Rally on Weak Jobs Report | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Wall Street Risk Complex Surges Anew Amid Deluge of Fresh Cash
top_news.summary: The financial world’s catalog of complaints keeps getting longer. In markets, however, the response is increasingly one of indifference.

top_news.title: Airbnb Jumps Most Since 2020 After Lifting Annual Outlook Again
top_news.summary: Airbnb Inc. had its biggest single-day stock rally in more than five years after boosting its annual revenue forecast for a second time this year.

top_news.title: This Spider-Man Is 'Deeper,' Say Sony's Rothman
top_news.summary: Sony Pictures Entertainment Motion Picture Group Chairman and CEO Tom Rothman says this latest Spider-Man movie was deeper and more emotional than others in the franchise.  He says "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" could be one of the studio's most profitable movies ever. Rothman also talks about ticket prices and making movies in California on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Hedge Funds Slashed Yen Short Bets After US-Japan Joint Efforts
top_news.summary: Hedge funds sharply reduced bearish bets on the yen after coordinated efforts by US and Japanese officials helped stabilize the currency.
